study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective, randomised trial
exposure: tactile stimulation during positive pressure ventilation (PPV)
cohort: The participants were newborn infants with a gestational age of >=34 weeks at birth, undergoing resuscitation in a single-centre delivery room.
finding: Tactile stimulation during PPV significantly increased the number of spontaneous breaths and VTe, without changing mask leak or obstruction, compared with the period immediately prior to stimulation.
